arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
APP=/srv/lowcost-europa
ACCOUNT="$(stat -c %U "$APP")"
OLD="$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse HEAD)"
test "$OLD" = "28c998e88bb723424c8ed36d4ba93904339ec877"
test -z "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal)"
for unit in lowcost-europa.service nginx.service postgresql.service; do systemctl is-active --quiet "$unit"; done
systemctl is-active --quiet lowcost-europa-affiliate-report.timer
test -x "$APP/.venv/bin/python"
test "$(df -Pm "$APP" | awk 'NR==2{print $4}')" -gt 1024
latest="$(sudo -n find /var/backups/lowcost-europa/daily -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'lowcost-europa-*.dump' -printf '%T@ %f\n' | sort -nr | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2-)"
[[ "$latest" =~ ^lowcost-europa-[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z\.dump$ ]]
dump="/var/backups/lowcost-europa/daily/$latest"
age=$(( ($(date -u +%s)-$(sudo -n stat -c %Y "$dump"))/3600 ))
test "$age" -ge 0 && test "$age" -lt 36
sudo -n bash -c 'cd /var/backups/lowcost-europa/daily && sha256sum --status -c "$1.sha256"' bash "$latest" >/dev/null 2>&1
sudo -n pg_restore --list "$dump" >/dev/null 2>&1
sudo -n test -f /var/lib/lowcost-europa/offsite-backup.last-success
marker_age=$(( ($(date -u +%s)-$(sudo -n stat -c %Y /var/lib/lowcost-europa/offsite-backup.last-success))/3600 ))
test "$marker_age" -ge 0 && test "$marker_age" -lt 36
echo "BACKUP_PREFLIGHT=pass age_hours=$age offsite_hours=$marker_age"
sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" fetch --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules https://github.com/martaxi-boss/lowcost-europa.git refs/heads/main >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "8b8bdaeaeb49f01def64b127f1b0c1459d5cf24e"
sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" merge-base --is-ancestor "$OLD" "8b8bdaeaeb49f01def64b127f1b0c1459d5cf24e"
changes="$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" diff --name-only "$OLD" FETCH_HEAD)"
for path in requirements/ config/settings/ apps/catalog/migrations/ apps/storefront/migrations/ deploy/nginx/ deploy/scripts/; do test -z "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" diff --name-only "$OLD" FETCH_HEAD -- "$path")"; done
echo "EXACT_GIT_PREFLIGHT=pass"
printf "CHANGED_FILES_BEGIN\n%s\nCHANGED_FILES_END\n" "$changes"
printf "TARGET_SHA=%s\n" "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)"
